2.2.1. Certification_LCF_Dump.config.Config¶

class Certification_LCF_Dump.config.Config(hll_dir, out_dir, gss_par_mappings, gss_int_mappings, strict_mode=True)¶

Methods

__init__(hll_dir, out_dir, gss_par_mappings, …)

Configuration for api.generate_certification_lcf()

Attributes

filter_types

If True (the default), unused user types will be filtered out from Types.lcf.

filter_unused_primary_tables

If True (the default), unused primary table types will be filtered out from Types.lcf.

gss_int_mappings

Returns a dict mapping the names of the INT_* functions in the HLL model to (class_name, var_name) tuples specifying the class and variable in the object model that the function represents.

gss_par_mappings

Returns a dict mapping the names of the PAR_* functions in the HLL model to (class_name, par_name) tuples, specifying the class and parameter in the object model that the function represents.

hll_dir

Path where the HLL certification files are located.

out_dir

Path where the LCF files will be created.

railyard_attributes_filter

The set of attributes to filter out in the railyard dump.

strict_mode

If True (the default), delete generated files if an error occurs.
